title: Transformers are Sample-Efficient World Models
layout_note: Imagination unrolled along one horizontal row of time steps (t = 0, 1, ..., s). Each step is a short vertical column: decode down to a predicted frame, then the policy elbows back up to the step's action, and G carries the row to the next step's tokens.
grouping: No fills or background panels. Curly underbraces labelled t = 0, t = 1 and t = s group the time steps along the bottom, with ellipses for the skipped steps. Three nested thin black rectangles, each one step wider than the one inside it, enclose the first steps and show the context growing. Each step's tokens z^1 ... z^K sit in a dashed rectangle. Arrow colour groups the components: green for E and D, dark indigo for G, magenta-purple for pi.
shapes_depth: All line art in a LaTeX/TikZ register: thin sharp-corner black rectangles (solid for the context windows, dashed for token sets) and thick coloured arrows with open chevron heads, drawn heavier than the box strokes. G's branches up to the predicted reward and done outputs, and pi's return from the predicted frame to the action, are right-angle elbows. All text is italic math (x_0, hat z, hat x, hat r, hat d, a_t); there are no icons, images, shading or 3-D.
proposed_highlight: Components are named only by single italic letters (E, D, G, pi) set beside their arrows in the arrow's own colour. The encoder and decoder share green, the transformer G is dark indigo and the policy pi magenta-purple, and the caption spells out the colour key. Hats (hat x, hat z, hat r, hat d) mark imagined quantities against the one real input x_0.
lesson: Show a transformer's growing context by nesting thin outline rectangles, each one time step wider, around the unrolled tokens, instead of drawing attention arrows.
notes: Only step t = 0 enters through E from a real observation x_0; later steps begin from tokens produced by G, and the last step (t = s) sits outside every context rectangle. The id uses the agent name IRIS, which the paper's abstract gives its method (the title has no name prefix). Venue as recorded from the PDF header; year = arXiv preprint year.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

core.what: the imagination rollout unrolled into time-step columns t=0, t=1, ..., t=s under braces, chained left to right by thick indigo G arrows

relations.form: three columns of the same unit (token box, action, decoder down, policy back up) marked by curly braces, with an ellipsis column between t=1 and t=s
within a column: x_0 down by green E into dashed token box z^1..z^K, down by green D to the reconstruction x-hat, then a magenta pi elbow back up to action a_t
nested thin rectangles around the tokens and actions of steps 0, 0-1 and 0-2 show the growing context G conditions on
from each G arrow a branch rises to the predicted reward r-hat and done d-hat at the top

channels.colour: arrow colour = which network: green = autoencoder E/D, indigo = world model G, magenta = policy pi; one meaning
channels.shape: dashed box = a frame's set of tokens; everything else is symbols on arrows (no network blocks)
channels.line: thick indigo = the world-model transition; thin coloured arrows = encoder, decoder, policy
channels.frame: nested solid rectangles = the accumulated context the transformer attends to; braces = one time step

quality.strengths: Unrolling is drawn as geometry: identical columns under braces, the transformer as the thick indigo spine, and the growing context as nested rectangles; each network keeps one colour everywhere.
quality.weaknesses: Everything is notation (x_0, z, x-hat, a, r-hat): no frame image or token grid; the nested context rectangles are unlabelled and need the caption; the pi path bends in an L from x-hat back up to a_t and the r-hat/d-hat branches step up from the spine.

insights.structure: A timeline unrolled left-to-right into time-step columns t=0, t=1, ..., t=s marked by curly braces at the bottom, each column holding a dashed token box z^1..z^K plus action a_t; nested plain rectangles around the growing token sequence show the transformer context expanding.
insights.data: Everything is math symbols: frame x_0, tokens z, reconstructions x-hat, actions a, predicted reward r-hat and done d-hat; no images or blocks for networks, which appear only as letters on arrows (E, D, G, pi).
insights.emphasis: Each network gets a colour on its arrows: green for encoder/decoder E/D, indigo for the world-model G (thick), magenta for policy pi, making the imagination loop readable without boxes.
insights.flow: x_0 drops down via E into tokens, D drops to x-hat, pi hooks back up to a_t, and thick indigo G arrows run right to the next step while branching upward to r-hat and d-hat.
insights.avoid: The nested context rectangles are thin unlabeled outlines whose meaning (growing attention window) is not stated in the figure.

arrangement.units: repeated unboxed time-step columns labeled by bottom braces; nested thin rectangles enclose the accumulated sequence
arrangement.shared: the same E, D, G, pi arrows repeat in every column
